approvalEvidence.scope: The explicitly attached Jet Scooter image, pixel-identical to Rev1, is accepted for comparative appearance review only; this does not approve production integration, gameplay, exact piece topology, source colors or hover presentation.

finding: The selected Rev1 reads clearly as the compact open 7303 Jet Scooter: one exposed Martian rider on a narrow low sled, two long parallel side tubes and two short forward nozzles. Its slightly fuller construction and visible controls are the director-selected appearance rather than the later simplified Rev2.

historicalBoundary: Source-rebuild Rev2 remains a historical unselected simplification.
